title: Comey charged a third time
caption: Former FBI Director James Comey, charged with transmitting national defense information in court papers unsealed Monday, says in a video statement that he is innocent. Prosecutors tie the case to a 2016 New York Times story; his lawyers say the charges, filed without a grand jury indictment, are time-barred. It is the Justice Department's third attempt to prosecute him in about a year.

stories.name: James Comey charged a third time
facts: Federal prosecutors charged former FBI Director James Comey with transmitting national defense information and conspiring to do so, in court papers unsealed Monday.
The case concerns an October 2016 New York Times story about a secret court order for Yahoo to scan emails; prosecutors say Comey had staff talk to the reporter.
The charges were filed as a criminal information, not a grand jury indictment; Comey's lawyers say they are time-barred. It is the third attempt to prosecute him in about a year.
Comey said in a video statement that he is innocent.

artwork.alt: Graphic poster illustration: former FBI Director James Comey, tall with receding grey hair, in a dark suit and blue tie, speaks toward a video camera on a tripod against a golden spotlight. On the desk beside him are three stacked case files; the top one is open, its papers fanned out and its red wax seal broken, representing newly unsealed charges, his third case.
